title: lsynth
summary: A Python toolkit implementing the MAP-alignment (Upsilon) fidelity statistic for evaluating how well synthetic tabular data preserves real conditional structure, separating generation from evaluation. It ships reference generators including SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as comparison baselines for its own QuasiNet-based generator.
